name: Raspberry Pi AI Camera
description: 12.3 MP Sony IMX500 CSI-2 camera that runs neural-network inference on the sensor and outputs tensor metadata with each frame.

specs.label: Sensor
specs.value: Sony IMX500, 12.3 MP (4056 × 3040), type 1/2.3, 1.55 µm pixels

specs.label: Lens
specs.value: 4.74 mm focal length, f/1.79, manual focus 20 cm – ∞, IR-cut integrated

specs.label: On-sensor AI
specs.value: Input tensor up to 640 × 640, int8/uint8, 8,388,480 bytes for firmware + weights + working memory

specs.label: Interface
specs.value: MIPI CSI-2; 15 × 1 mm or 22 × 0.5 mm FPC, 200 mm cable

envelope.axes: x = PCB width (25 mm), y = PCB height incl. connector edge (23.862 mm), z = overall depth (11.9 mm, product brief spec table)

features.label: PCB outline
features.value: 25 × 23.862 mm; identical outline and hole positions to Camera Module 3

features.label: Mounting holes
features.value: 4× Ø2.2 mm. Centers 2.0 mm from the left/right edges (21 mm pitch along x) and 2.0 mm and 14.5 mm from the edge opposite the connector (12.5 mm pitch along y)

features.label: Lens position
features.value: Lens center on the x centerline (12.5 mm) and 14.4 mm from the edge opposite the connector (= 9.462 mm from the connector edge); lens front Ø5.75 mm

features.label: Side-view dimensions
features.value: Drawing labels 1 and 1.12 (PCB/flex stack), 2.75, 3.875 and 6.98 (lens stack steps), 5.71 and 2.55 (rear connector); FOV cones 66.3° and 52.3°. Read from the drawing; the brief says dimensions are approximate

features.label: Other callouts
features.value: Ø4.75 (ring near the lower-right hole, likely pad/keep-out), 19.5 and 12.5 (vertical callouts on the left of the front view), 19.61 (rear connector width in the bottom view)

amazon.title: Raspberry Pi AI Camera (URL slug Raspberry-Pi-SC1174-AI-Camera)

notes: The AI Camera's PIP category (1044) lists only the product brief, cable drawing, Picamera2 manual and compliance docs; no Design Files category and no STEP. The product brief's drawing is marked approximate/reference only. The brief states the PCB outline and holes match Camera Module 3 while the depth is greater, so the CM3 STEP was downloaded as a PCB reference only (wide-FOV variant discarded). Amazon ASIN verified by title.
